title: Revisions
intro: Every commit, confirmed commit and rollback is saved as a revision. Compare any two, or roll back to an earlier one — a rollback is itself a new revision.
readonlyNote: Signed in as {{role}}: you can browse and compare revisions; rolling back needs an operator or administrator.

compare.label: Compare revisions
compare.initial: Revision {{to}} (first revision, compared with an empty configuration)

rollback.title: Roll back to revision {{id}}
rollback.body: The configuration of revision {{id}} is validated and applied as a new revision. The history is kept.
rollback.willChange: What changes compared with the running configuration
rollback.dirty: There are uncommitted changes. Commit or discard them first.
rollback.isRunning: This revision is the running configuration.
